fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-hosted rulebook title image identifies the Risk edition discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Hasbro's item 00044 English PDF contains this illustrated Risk: The Game of Global Domination title panel on the first sheet, alongside a 1999 Hasbro copyright and print code 00044-1. The title panel was rotated into reading orientation and reduced to 229 × 360 pixels. This depicts the actual rulebook cover, not a game box.

firstPlayerRule: During initial army placement, every player rolls one die. The highest roller places the first infantry unit; placement then continues clockwise. That same player takes the first regular turn.
clarifications: This is the Global Domination game for three to six players; the rulebook has other modes with different setup.
